Builder floors, rooftops full of tanks

South City 1 and 2 and Sushant Lok are largely plotted colonies. Many plots have been rebuilt as builder floors, while others are still independent houses. In a typical builder floor, each floor has its own rooftop tank and all of them are fed from one shared underground sump. Walk onto one of these roofs and you may find three or four plastic tanks side by side, each with its own owner and its own cleaning history.

The sump is often under the stilt parking or the driveway, with a manhole that a car sometimes parks on. It is easy to forget about, which is exactly why it fills with sludge. Independent houses here usually have the same pieces on a smaller scale: one or two rooftop tanks and a sump of their own.

Why tanks here get dirty

Fine silt in supply water settles in the sump first and then in each rooftop tank. Rooftop tanks bake in the summer sun, so algae grows on the walls and under the lid. Where a building tops up with tanker or borewell water, sediment tends to build up faster. And when one floor cleans its tank but the shared sump is left alone, that tank picks up sludge again from below within weeks.

Getting a builder floor ready for cleaning

  1. Agree among the floors which tanks to clean. Cleaning the sump and all rooftop tanks together gives the best result.
  2. Send the details from the quote form or on WhatsApp: how many rooftop tanks, rough sizes and where the sump is.
  3. Get a free fixed quote on WhatsApp, including GST, and pick a slot.
  4. On the day, keep the manhole clear of cars, the roof door open and the inlet off the night before so levels drop.
  5. We clean each tank in about 60 to 90 minutes: suction, jet wash, food-safe disinfectant, clean-water flush and drying.
  6. Check the before and after photos on WhatsApp and pay after the job by UPI or cash.

What we clean here

We clean rooftop plastic tanks on builder floors and houses, and underground concrete sumps from the manhole, so nobody goes down into a tight, airless space. If your building or a group of neighbours has 5 or more tanks, bulk rates apply; see society and RWA cleaning.

Nearby areas: we also clean tanks in DLF Phase 1 to 5 and along Sohna Road.

Questions

Our sump is under the stilt parking. Is that a problem?

No. We only need the manhole uncovered and a car moved if it is parked on top. Hoses run from there.

Can you clean all four floors' tanks and the sump in one visit?

Yes. Each tank takes about 60 to 90 minutes, so plan for a few hours. One fixed quote covers all of them.

Only my floor wants cleaning. Can I book just my tank?

Yes. But if the shared sump is dirty, sludge comes back up into your tank, so it is worth asking the other floors about the sump.
